exposure.basis: The detector checkpoint is trained on COCO 2017 only (resolved config 377d9f57); no MAVI record names VisDrone; VisDrone images are not COCO images.

nativeTaxonomy.definition: VisDrone category 'pedestrian' (1): a person standing or walking.
nativeTaxonomy.name: Pedestrian

nativeTaxonomy.definition: VisDrone category 'people' (2): a person in another pose (sitting, lying, riding).
nativeTaxonomy.name: People

nativeTaxonomy.definition: VisDrone category 'car' (4). No written definition in the toolkit README; meaning from the name in an aerial road-scene dataset.
nativeTaxonomy.name: Car

nativeTaxonomy.definition: VisDrone category 'van' (5), annotated separately from car and truck.
nativeTaxonomy.name: Van

nativeTaxonomy.definition: VisDrone category 'truck' (6). No written definition in the toolkit README.
nativeTaxonomy.name: Truck

nativeTaxonomy.definition: VisDrone category 'awning-tricycle' (8): a three-wheeled vehicle with an awning.
nativeTaxonomy.name: Awning tricycle

nativeTaxonomy.definition: VisDrone category 'bus' (9). No written definition in the toolkit README.
nativeTaxonomy.name: Bus

nativeTaxonomy.definition: VisDrone category 'motor' (10): a motorised two-wheeler (the rider is annotated as people).
nativeTaxonomy.name: Motor

nativeTaxonomy.definition: VisDrone category 'others' (11): an object of no listed category.
nativeTaxonomy.name: Others

release: VisDrone2019-MOT (val, test-dev; toolkit v1.0.2 category scheme)

researchUse.basis: Openly obtainable without registration; the dataset repository states no licence, and the MOT toolkit says it is 'for research purpose only' and asks for citation. Used for Development benchmarking only; not redistributed.

source.credibilityBasis: The dataset authors' repository (AISKYEYE team, Tianjin University) links the release archives on the authors' Google Drive; archive bytes are pinned by SHA-256 in the H4 methodology freeze.
